# Third-party CBOM samples

`flick-cbom.json`, `kafka-cbom.json` and `keycloak-cbom.json` are unmodified copies of the `example/` files of PQCA/cbomkit at commit
`eea204303f53bd13192cc9770a917c938238f6ed`, which is licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (https://github.com/PQCA/cbomkit/blob/main/LICENSE.txt).
CBOMkit's README states that its scanning is the Sonar Cryptography Plugin (CBOMkit-hyperion), so these are what that generator writes.
They are test inputs only: no code from either project is used. Not obtained: output of a SonarQube run, which needs Java and a SonarQube server.
